subject: Traceable commitments MAP — draft & kickoff workshop
messages:
From: Priya Singh <psingh@cloudstride.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Traceable commitments MAP - draft request

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency/throughput slides were helpful. The procurement and security teams asked me to get a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that surfaces: commitments, acceptance criteria, and evidence we can hand to auditors (SOC 2 scope). Can you share a template your team uses? We're trying to map who owns each check and what the deliverables look like.

High level asks:
- Clear acceptance criteria per milestone (pass/fail) with an evidence log
- Timeline to obtain SOC 2 evidence and contact for security Qs
- Simple owner/role column (customer vs Redwood)

If you have an editable doc and a 30–45 minute workshop slot next week to walk our stakeholders through the template, that would be great.

Best,
Priya
Procurement Lead | Cloudstride

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Singh <psingh@cloudstride.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Traceable commitments MAP - draft request

Hi Priya — great to hear.

I've attached a lightweight MAP template and a slides stub that teams can use for a kickoff. Key sections I recommend we keep in the first draft:
- Outcome & success metric
- Milestone (date window)
- Owner (R/RACI simplified)
- Acceptance criteria (explicit pass/fail)
- Evidence artifact (link or filename)
- Escalation/triggers (who to call if blocked)

Attachments:
- MAP-stub-slides.pptx (slide deck stub)
- MAP-template-traceable-v1.gdoc (editable template)
- ops-evidence-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet with common artifacts)

Next steps I propose:
1) I will seed the MAP with a 10-day validation sprint (Day 0 tech kickoff -> Day 10 acceptance) and include an evidence log.
2) Schedule a 45-minute walkthrough with your procurement + security to align acceptance criteria.

Proposed slots: Tue 11/3 10:00–10:45 or Wed 11/4 14:00–14:45 PT. I can invite Marissa and Ben from our ops and CS teams to cover evidence and performance SLAs.

Link to draft doc (view/edit): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcD-Traceable-MAP

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Traceable commitments MAP - draft request

Eve — thanks for seeding this. A couple of ops notes:

- Add an 'Evidence owner' column separate from Owner to make handoff clear (sometimes procurement wants a named contact at Redwood for each artifact).
- Include an 'Acceptance window' not just a single date — we've seen customers need ±3 days for scheduling tests.
- Add a small row for required artifacts for SOC 2 (audit reports, config screenshots, retention policy link). We can point them to our compliance pack.

I'll drop suggested language into the gdoc where appropriate. Also recommend we include a short 'What good looks like' checklist per milestone — one sentence, measurable.

Marissa
Director, Customer Ops
Redwood Inference

Quick input from CS/engineering perspective:

- Sequence: Technical validation (sandbox onboarding) -> Performance smoke tests -> Security evidence handoff -> Acceptance sign-off.
- Rename 'Week 1 tech check' to 'Day 1 smoke test' to signal an early, quick pass/fail checkpoint.
- Add a row for 'rollback criteria' in case the deployment shows regressions during the pilot.

I'll add a recommended performance SLA row (p99 latency under X ms for the benchmark prompt set) to the doc and stub a standard verification command we run in the sandbox.

Ben
